zh.title: 防火牆與偵測：允許、阻擋、警示要分開驗證
zh.summary: 網路控制與偵測系統提供不同證據。用一張控制矩陣，檢查合法流量、禁止流量與應被觀察的事件。
objectives: 區分防火牆政策、IDS 警示與 IPS 阻擋。
解釋沒有警示為何不等於沒有事件。

sections.heading: 不同控制有不同責任
paragraphs: 防火牆依政策控制流量；IDS 觀察並提出警示；IPS 可在流量路徑上執行阻擋。實際產品可能整合多種能力，所以要核對目前部署的位置、模式與規則，而不是只看產品名稱。
蜜罐可提供誘餌資產上的互動線索，但它看到的也只有自身可見的部分。此章雖沿用官方章節名稱，入門單元著重防禦驗證；不提供繞過真實監控的操作。

sections.heading: 把預期與觀察放在同一張表
paragraphs: 矩陣列出來源、目的地、協定、動作及預期結果，再記實際允許／阻擋與是否警示。合法服務被誤擋是可用性問題；禁止流量被允許是政策問題；事件發生卻沒告警可能是偵測或收集問題。
沒有警示時先核對感測器是否看到事件、規則是否適用、時鐘與傳送流程是否正常。不要在沒有這些證據時，把安靜的儀表板當成沒有攻擊的證明。

example.title: 例子：允許網頁、拒絕管理埠
example.scenario: 虛構政策允許訪客至 443，拒絕訪客至管理埠，並要求記錄拒絕事件。合成結果顯示兩者都被拒絕，但只有管理埠有日誌。
example.reasoning: 管理埠的阻擋符合政策；443 的阻擋破壞合法功能。若只測禁止案例，就會漏掉這個問題。日誌是否完整還要比對宣告的記錄需求。
example.conclusion: 至少需要一個允許案例與一個拒絕案例，以及各自的觀測證據。

lab.title: 離線練習：控制矩陣
lab.environment: 只填合成表格，不改防火牆或監控設定。
steps: 建立訪客→443 與訪客→管理埠兩列。
填入預期、實際結果與日誌是否存在。
指出需要修正的規則與需要補查的觀測。
lab.expected: 443 應恢復合法存取；管理埠拒絕保留；記錄要求另行核對。
lab.check: 為何「所有流量都擋掉」不一定代表驗收成功？
lab.cleanup: 保留矩陣；沒有真實規則需要回復。

en.title: Firewalls and detection: verify allow, block and alert separately
en.summary: Network controls and detection systems provide different evidence. Use a control matrix to check legitimate traffic, prohibited traffic and events that should be observed.
objectives: Distinguish firewall policy, IDS alerts and IPS blocking.
Explain why no alert does not imply no event.

sections.heading: Different controls have different jobs
paragraphs: A firewall controls traffic according to policy. An IDS observes and alerts. An IPS can block traffic on its path. Products may combine these abilities, so check deployment location, mode and rules rather than relying on a product label.

A honeypot can provide clues from interactions with a decoy asset, but its view is also limited. Although the module follows the official chapter structure, this introductory unit focuses on defensive validation and supplies no procedure for bypassing real monitoring.

sections.heading: Put expectations and observations in one table
paragraphs: List source, destination, protocol, action and expected result, then record actual allowance, blocking and alerts. Blocking a legitimate service affects availability. Allowing prohibited traffic violates policy. An event without an alert may indicate a detection or collection gap.
With no alert, check whether the sensor saw the event, whether a rule applies, and whether clocks and forwarding work. A quiet dashboard is not proof of no attack without those checks.

example.title: Example: allow web traffic, deny an administration port
example.scenario: A fictional policy allows visitors to 443, denies them an administration port and logs denials. Synthetic results show both blocked, with only the administration-port denial logged.
example.reasoning: Blocking administration matches policy; blocking 443 breaks legitimate functionality. Testing only prohibited cases would miss it. Log completeness must also be compared with the stated logging requirement.
example.conclusion: Include at least one allow case, one deny case and evidence for both.

lab.title: Offline exercise: a control matrix
lab.environment: Fill a synthetic table without changing firewalls or monitoring.
steps: Enter expected and observed outcomes and log presence.
Identify the rule needing correction and the observation requiring follow-up.
lab.expected: Restore legitimate 443 access, retain the administration denial and check logging requirements separately.
lab.check: Why does blocking every flow not necessarily pass acceptance?
lab.cleanup: Keep the matrix; no real rules require rollback.

zh.prompt: IDS 沒有警示，首先能說什麼？
options: 一定所有封包都被阻擋
目前未見警示，需核對可見性與規則
rationales: IDS 警示與阻擋不是同一件事。
這保留觀察與待核對條件。
也沒有支持已入侵的證據。

en.prompt: What can first be said when an IDS shows no alert?
options: No alert is visible; visibility and rules need checking
rationales: No alert does not establish absence.
IDS alerting and blocking are distinct.
This preserves the observation and unresolved conditions.
It also does not establish compromise.

zh.prompt: 測試防火牆時，為何要包含合法流量？
options: 避免安全規則破壞必要服務
只要合法流量通過就不用測其他項目
因為日誌不能記錄拒絕
rationales: 控制需要同時滿足保護與功能要求。
合法案例不改變禁止政策。
拒絕與觀測案例仍需要測試。
系統可以記錄拒絕，取決於配置。

en.prompt: Why include legitimate traffic in firewall testing?
options: To detect rules that break necessary services
If it passes, no other tests are needed
rationales: Controls need to satisfy protection and functional requirements.
Legitimate cases do not change deny policy.
Denial and observation cases still need testing.
Systems can log denials depending on configuration.
